name: Alpha Reward / Gold Rush (Alpha Boost)
source: Locally installed Rocket League CookedPCConsole packages
implementation: 32 small textured GPU-instanced billboards in one draw call, mounted on two rear nozzles. Original texture images and gold RGB values; adapted WebGL particle shader. UE3 Cascade simulation, exact material graph/distortion, mesh emitter, and original audio are not reproduced.
